name: customer-complaint-intelligence
description: Bounded Codex skills for complaint intelligence plus a local Customer Complaint Demo initializer.

interface.shortDescription: Turn complaint emails into evidence and action.
interface.longDescription: Five bounded skills help a human create a local complaint demo project, extract complaint data from Gmail, analyze it with local customer data, investigate findings through source emails, and apply approved labels back to Gmail.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the Customer Complaint Demo project.
Turn my Gmail complaints into a structured CSV.
Analyze the complaint register with my customer data and investigate the evidence.
